capabilities: Convert folders of documents to Markdown notes
Inspect page composition and text coverage
Extract partial text from mixed PDFs
Hand off excluded originals to external OCR tools
extras: Desktop only; needs a separately installed Python environment and matching plugin bundle. A legacy CLI path can contact a configured provider and incur charges, but the strict conversion workflow needs no API key. No client telemetry is sent.
intentEvidence: The original obsidian-markitdown project by Ethan Troy is credited under the MIT license.
problem: Obsidian cannot turn PDFs and other documents into notes, and simple converters silently produce incomplete notes from partly scanned files.

relations.evidence: The original obsidian-markitdown project by Ethan Troy is credited under the MIT license.
The optional ExifTool process receives a private copy of the selected image for a bounded, field-scoped read.

summary: Converts local documents to Markdown notes, holding back mixed or scanned files for external OCR.
